meta_description: A&L Painters & Decorators in Liverpool. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full redecoration. Free quotes, reliable local team.
hero_eyebrow: Local Liverpool Team — Fully Insured & Reliable
hero_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting for homes and businesses across Liverpool. Free quotes, no mess, on-time every time.
services_subhead: From single-room updates to full house redecorations, we handle interior painting, wallpapering, exterior work, and commercial projects.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork finished to a high standard. We prep properly, use quality paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for fascias, soffits, doors, and rendered walls. We work safely at height and protect your garden throughout.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging, including patterned and feature walls. We remove old paper, prepare surfaces, and ensure perfect alignment.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, architraves, and fitted furniture painted or varnished. We sand, prime, and finish with care for a long-lasting result.

services.title: Damp-Proof & Preparation Work
services.desc: We identify moisture issues, treat affected areas, and prepare walls properly before decoration—ensuring finishes last.

services.title: Commercial & Office Redecoration
services.desc: Quick turnarounds for shops, offices, and rental properties. We work flexibly around your business hours and minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: We do the job right the first time—no rushing, no shortcuts, no excuses.
about_para_1: A&L Painters & Decorators was founded in 2006 by two local Liverpool tradesmen who were tired of seeing shoddy work in their neighbourhood. We've built our reputation on turning up on time, doing the job properly, and leaving customers genuinely happy. In nearly two decades, we've decorated over 1,000 homes and businesses across Merseyside—from terraced houses in Anfield to period properties in Mossley Hill.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat every job seriously, whether it's a single bedroom or a full commercial refit. We listen to what you want, give honest advice, and use quality materials that last. Word of mouth is our best advertisement—most of our work comes from repeat customers and their referrals.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About A&L

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our hallway and landing. Alan was really professional—sorted the cracks in the plaster before painting, and the finish is immaculate. He cleaned up every day and was in and out on schedule. Can't fault it.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge redecorated. They moved furniture without being asked, protected everything, and matched the paint on the coving perfectly. Fair price too. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Our kitchen was looking tired. A&L transformed it with fresh paint and new handles. Worked around us being in the house, tidy workers, and it's made a real difference. Thanks lads!
reviews.author: Sarah L.
